units.source_text: 每個月我都會購買十幾種剛剛上市的少年雜誌，另外，我還從東京郵購各種書籍，默默閱讀，

en.t: Every month I bought more than a dozen newly released boys' magazines, and I also ordered all kinds of books from Tokyo and quietly read them,

units.source_text: 所以對「妹卡拉苦卡拉博士」「什什東東博士」[2]我都如數家珍。

en.t: so I knew Doctor Mecharakuchara and Doctor Nanjamonja [2] inside and out.

units.source_text: 還有怪談、講談、落語、江戶趣談之類的也樣樣精通。

en.t: I was also well versed in ghost stories, storytelling, rakugo, Edo anecdotes, and the like.

units.source_text: 所以，我常常一本正經地說些笑話，逗大家哈哈大笑。

en.t: So I often told jokes with a perfectly serious face and made everyone burst out laughing.

units.source_text: 我在學校裡頗受人尊敬。

en.t: At school I was quite respected.

units.source_text: 「受人尊敬」這種觀念本身就令我發怵。

en.t: The very idea of being respected frightened me.
